exercises.question: The study found a strong ---- between screen time and poor sleep, but it could not establish that one caused the other.
exercises.explanation: Cümle iki değişkenin birlikte görüldüğünü ama neden-sonuç kurulamadığını söyler → 'correlation' (bağıntı). Tuzak: 'causation' (nedensellik) cümlenin ikinci yarısıyla çelişir; neden-sonuç kurulamadıysa nedensellik bulunmuş olamaz.

exercises.question: Most reviewers praised the book, but they added one important ----: its conclusions rely on a very small sample.
exercises.explanation: Övgüden sonra gelen *but* ve küçük örneklem uyarısı bir çekinceyi gösterir → 'caveat'. 'Acclaim' övgü demektir; *but* ile gelen olumsuz bilgiyle çelişir. 'Consensus' bir kişinin eklediği uyarı olamaz.

exercises.question: Investors remain ---- of the new company, given the failure of its previous projects.
exercises.explanation: Önceki projelerin başarısızlığı yatırımcıları temkinli yapar; *be wary of* kalıbı → 'wary'. 'Sympathetic' hem anlamca uymaz hem de *of* ile değil *to/towards* ile kullanılır; 'intrinsic' ve 'longitudinal' insanları nitelemez.

exercises.question: The effects of the policy ---- from one school to another, so the authors could not draw a single conclusion.
exercises.explanation: Tek bir sonuç çıkarılamamasının nedeni etkilerin okuldan okula çok farklı olmasıdır → 'varied widely'. 'Levelled off' (durağanlaştı) bir değişkenin zamanla sabitlenmesidir ve *from one school to another* ile uyuşmaz; 'set out to' arkasından fiil ister.

exercises.question: The new findings are ---- earlier claims that the drug is completely safe, so the trial has been suspended.
exercises.explanation: Bulgular önceki "tamamen güvenli" iddiasıyla çelişir ve deneme durdurulur → 'at odds with'. 'On the grounds that' arkasından tam cümle ister; 'pertain to' bir fiildir ve *are* ile kullanılamaz.

exercises.text: Researchers should not ___ from such a small sample to the whole population.
exercises.translation: Araştırmacılar böyle küçük bir örneklemden bütün nüfusa genelleme yapmamalı.

exercises.question: The project was ---- designed to help small farmers, but in practice it mainly benefited large companies.
exercises.explanation: *but in practice* görünüş ile gerçeğin farklı olduğunu gösterir → 'ostensibly' (görünüşte, sözde). 'Respectively' iki öğeyi sırayla eşleştirir; burada eşleşecek liste yoktur. 'Notwithstanding' edattır, zarf yerine kullanılamaz.

exercises.passage: In 2019, the fictional district of Lornwick switched its secondary schools to a four-day week, largely to cut transport and heating costs. Early reports from the district were enthusiastic: attendance rose slightly, and teachers said they valued the extra day for planning. A longitudinal study published five years later, however, paints a more complicated picture. Test scores in mathematics fell modestly in the first two years before levelling off, while reading scores showed no significant change. The researchers note that the savings were smaller than expected, at roughly two per cent of the annual budget, partly because many families had to pay for childcare on the fifth day. They also point out that the effects varied widely between schools: those that used the free day for supervised clubs saw almost no decline in results. The authors are careful not to recommend or reject the policy outright. Instead, they argue that its success appears to depend less on the number of school days than on what happens on the day without lessons.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the early reports from the district ----.
options: were written by the researchers who conducted the study
presented the change in a more positive light than later evidence justified
showed that families saved money on childcare
focused mainly on the decline in mathematics scores
were based on the longitudinal study that was published five years later by researchers
exercises.explanation: İlk raporlar *enthusiastic* idi; *however* ile gelen uzun süreli çalışma tabloyu karmaşıklaştırır. Demek ki ilk raporlar durumu olduğundan olumlu göstermiştir → 'presented the change in a more positive light than later evidence justified'. 'Were based on the longitudinal study' zaman bakımından imkânsızdır: çalışma beş yıl sonra çıktı.

options: Students' physical health improved under the four-day schedule.
Reading scores did not change significantly.
Mathematics scores declined for a period before stabilising.
The financial savings were smaller than anticipated.
Schools offering supervised clubs saw little decline in results.

Öteki dört bilgi metinde geçer: matematikte düşüş sonra durağanlaşma, okumada anlamlı değişim olmaması, tasarrufun beklenenden az olması, kulüp düzenleyen okullarda neredeyse düşüş olmaması.

exercises.question: The researchers' attitude towards the four-day week can best be described as ----.
options: mocking, since they consider the policy absurd
indifferent, since they did not examine its effects
wholly enthusiastic, since it saved a great deal of money
openly hostile, since they believe it harmed every school in the district
cautious, since they link its success to particular conditions
exercises.explanation: Yazarlar politikayı ne önerir ne reddeder; başarının boş günde ne yapıldığına bağlı olduğunu söyler → 'cautious, since they link its success to particular conditions'. 'Openly hostile' aşırı genellemedir (kulüp düzenleyen okullarda düşüş yok); 'wholly enthusiastic' metinle çelişir (tasarruf beklenenden az).

exercises.question: According to the passage, the savings were lower than expected partly because ----.
options: heating costs rose sharply during the unusually cold winter months that followed
supervised clubs turned out to be expensive to run
many families had to spend money on childcare on the extra day
attendance fell after the change was introduced

exercises.passage: For decades, farmers in the fictional Kestrin Valley removed the hedgerows between their fields to make room for larger machinery. The practice was widely seen as a sign of modern, efficient agriculture. A recent survey of forty farms, however, suggests that the gains may have come at a hidden price. Farms that had kept at least some hedgerows reported fewer outbreaks of the aphids that damage wheat, apparently because the hedges shelter the beetles and small birds that feed on these pests. Such farms also used about a fifth less pesticide. The authors of the survey admit that their data cannot prove that the hedgerows themselves caused these differences; the farmers who kept them may simply have been more careful managers in general. Even so, the pattern was consistent across soil types and farm sizes, which, in their view, makes a purely accidental link unlikely. They are now planning a controlled trial in which hedgerows will be replanted on half of a group of farms.
exercises.question: The authors mention that the pattern was consistent across soil types and farm sizes in order to ----.
options: prove that hedgerows definitely reduce pest outbreaks
show that soil type is the main cause of aphid outbreaks on farms of every size
suggest that larger farms use more pesticide
argue that the connection they found is probably not a coincidence
explain why farmers originally removed the hedgerows
exercises.explanation: Yazarlar kesin kanıt sunamadıklarını kabul eder, ama örüntünün tutarlı olmasının *a purely accidental link unlikely* yaptığını söyler → 'argue that the connection they found is probably not a coincidence'. 'Prove that hedgerows definitely reduce …' aşırı genellemedir; yazarlar *cannot prove* der.

exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the planned controlled trial is intended to ----.
options: persuade farmers to buy larger machinery
replace pesticides completely within a single year on all the farms in the valley
measure the profits of the largest farms in the valley
establish whether the hedgerows themselves reduce pest problems
compare wheat with other crops grown in the valley
exercises.explanation: Anket nedenselliği kanıtlayamadığı için (*cannot prove that the hedgerows themselves caused these differences*) çiftliklerin yarısına çit dikilecek kontrollü deney bu soruyu yanıtlamak içindir → 'establish whether the hedgerows themselves reduce pest problems'. 'Replace pesticides completely' metinde dayanağı olmayan aşırı bir iddiadır.

exercises.question: Which of the following best describes how the passage presents the removal of hedgerows?
options: As the main reason for the fall in wheat prices
As a practice once considered progressive whose costs may have been underestimated
As a method that has been proven to increase pest numbers
As a mistake that every farmer in the valley now openly regrets and is trying hard to correct
As a tradition that was never widely accepted by farmers
exercises.explanation: Çitlerin sökülmesi *a sign of modern, efficient agriculture* sayılmıştı, ama *hidden price* olabileceği belirtilir → 'As a practice once considered progressive whose costs may have been underestimated'. 'Proven to increase pest numbers' metnin *cannot prove* ifadesiyle çelişir; 'never widely accepted' ise *widely seen as … efficient* ile çelişir.

exercises.passage: When the fictional Ostrava Maritime Museum replaced its printed labels with an audio guide app, the museum's director expected visitors to stay longer and learn more. Visitor numbers did rise steadily in the first year, but an internal review found that the average time spent in each gallery had actually fallen. Many visitors, the review noted, listened to the first few recordings and then put their phones away, moving quickly through the remaining rooms. Older visitors in particular complained that they could no longer read the information at their own pace. Interestingly, the galleries that kept a few large wall panels alongside the app were the only ones where visiting time increased. The review does not conclude that digital guides are a failure. Rather, it suggests that technology works better as an addition to traditional displays than as a replacement for them, and it recommends that printed information be restored in the main galleries.
exercises.question: The main conclusion of the museum's review is that ----.
options: the audio guide app should be withdrawn immediately and replaced with printed labels
visitor numbers fell after the app was introduced
older visitors are unable to use smartphones
wall panels are more expensive than audio guides
digital guides work best when combined with traditional forms of information
exercises.explanation: İnceleme dijital rehberi başarısız saymaz; teknolojinin geleneksel sergilere eklenti olarak daha iyi çalıştığını söyler → 'digital guides work best when combined with traditional forms of information'. 'Should be withdrawn immediately' metindeki *does not conclude that digital guides are a failure* ile çelişir; 'visitor numbers fell' de yanlıştır, sayı arttı.

exercises.question: It is clear from the passage that the director's expectations ----.

concerned only the number of visitors
were based on complaints from older visitors

exercises.explanation: Müdür ziyaretçilerin daha uzun kalmasını ve daha çok öğrenmesini bekliyordu: ziyaretçi sayısı arttı ama galeride geçen süre düştü → 'were only partly met'. 'Fully met' süre düşüşüyle çelişir; 'concerned only the number of visitors' yanlıştır, çünkü beklenti kalış süresini de kapsıyordu.

exercises.question: Which of the following is NOT stated in the passage?

Older visitors missed reading information at their own pace.

exercises.passage: It has long been assumed that sleep helps to consolidate newly learned vocabulary, and a growing body of laboratory evidence appears to support this view. A study conducted at the fictional Halden Institute, however, has added an unexpected qualification. Volunteers learned forty invented words in the evening and were tested the following morning. Those who had slept for at least seven hours recalled considerably more words than those who had been kept awake, a result consistent with earlier work. Yet when the volunteers were tested again a week later, the advantage had largely disappeared for words that had been studied only once. It persisted only for words that the participants had reviewed briefly before going to bed. The researchers therefore propose that sleep does not so much store new information as strengthen information that the brain has already marked as important, and that a short review may serve as such a marker. They caution that their sample consisted entirely of university students and that invented words lack the meaning and context of real vocabulary. Nonetheless, they suggest that learners might gain more from a ten-minute review before sleep than from an extra hour of study earlier in the day.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the Halden study differed from earlier research in that it ----.
options: examined whether the benefit of sleep lasted beyond the following morning
tested volunteers who had been kept awake for a week
used real vocabulary instead of invented words
included participants from a wide range of age groups and educational backgrounds
found that sleep has no effect at all on vocabulary learning
exercises.explanation: Sabah testi önceki çalışmalarla tutarlıdır (*consistent with earlier work*); yeni olan bir hafta sonraki ikinci testtir → 'examined whether the benefit of sleep lasted beyond the following morning'. 'Used real vocabulary' metinle çelişir (uydurma kelimeler kullanıldı); 'a wide range of age groups' da yanlıştır, örneklemin tamamı üniversite öğrencisiydi.

will be forgotten by the next morning whether or not the learner sleeps well that night

'Will be forgotten by the next morning' yanlıştır: sabah testinde uyuyanlar daha çok kelime hatırladı.

exercises.question: Which of the following would the researchers most probably recommend to a learner?
options: Learning only invented words before an exam
Studying for an extra hour early in the morning instead of sleeping
Avoiding any kind of study in the evening
Briefly going over new words shortly before going to sleep
Sleeping at least ten hours after learning new words
exercises.explanation: Son cümle yatmadan önce on dakikalık tekrarın, gün içinde fazladan bir saatten daha yararlı olabileceğini söyler → 'Briefly going over new words shortly before going to sleep'. 'Studying for an extra hour … instead of sleeping' önerinin tam tersidir; 'ten hours' metinde geçmez.

exercises.passage: When the fictional city council of Tarnby faced fierce public opposition to its plans for a new ring road, it tried an unusual approach. Instead of holding another round of public meetings, it selected eighty residents by lottery, chosen to reflect the city's mix of ages, incomes and neighbourhoods, and asked them to recommend a solution. Over six weekends the group heard from engineers, environmental groups and local businesses before voting on a proposal. Their final recommendation, a smaller road combined with an expanded bus network, was adopted almost unchanged by the council. Supporters of such citizens' assemblies argue that ordinary people, given time and good information, can reach more balanced decisions than politicians who must worry about re-election. Critics, on the other hand, question whether eighty people can legitimately speak for a city of 300,000, and point out that the experts invited to speak inevitably shape the outcome. A survey conducted a year later suggests that both sides have a point: public trust in the decision was notably higher than for previous transport projects, yet fewer than a third of residents knew that the assembly had existed.
exercises.question: The passage is mainly concerned with ----.
options: the reasons why Tarnby's council lost an election
the history of public transport in Tarnby
an experiment in public decision-making and the debate surrounding it
the methods used to choose experts for public meetings
the engineering problems involved in building ring roads around small historic cities
exercises.explanation: Metin kurayla seçilen bir yurttaş meclisini, sonucunu, destekçilerin ve eleştirmenlerin görüşlerini anlatır → 'an experiment in public decision-making and the debate surrounding it'. 'Engineering problems' ve 'history of public transport' metinde geçen kelimeleri (*engineers, bus network*) kullanan ama ana fikri kaçıran şıklardır.

exercises.question: Critics of citizens' assemblies are concerned that ----.
options: politicians will refuse to follow their recommendations
the lottery tends to favour wealthy residents
ordinary people are incapable of understanding complex engineering and financial questions
the views of a small group may not represent those of a whole city
such assemblies take far too long to reach a decision
exercises.explanation: Eleştirmenler 80 kişinin 300.000 kişilik bir kent adına konuşup konuşamayacağını sorgular → 'the views of a small group may not represent those of a whole city'. 'The lottery tends to favour wealthy residents' metinle çelişir (seçim gelir dağılımını yansıtacak biçimde yapıldı); 'politicians will refuse' de yanlıştır, öneri neredeyse aynen kabul edildi.

exercises.passage: When the fictional city council of Tarnby faced fierce public opposition to its plans for a new ring road, it tried an unusual approach. Instead of holding another round of public meetings, it selected eighty residents by lottery, chosen to reflect the city's mix of ages, incomes and neighbourhoods, and asked them to recommend a solution. exercises.question: The survey mentioned in the last sentence suggests that ----.
options: the assembly increased trust in the decision even though many residents were unaware of it
the critics of the assembly were completely wrong
most residents took part in at least one of the assembly's meetings and approved of its final proposal
the council eventually rejected the assembly's recommendation
public trust in transport projects fell after the assembly
exercises.explanation: Anket hem güvenin arttığını hem de sakinlerin üçte birinden azının meclisi bildiğini gösterir; *both sides have a point* → 'the assembly increased trust in the decision even though many residents were unaware of it'. 'The critics … were completely wrong' metnin *both sides have a point* yargısıyla çelişen aşırı bir genellemedir.

exercises.passage: When the fictional city council of Tarnby faced fierce public opposition to its plans for a new ring road, it tried an unusual approach. exercises.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned about the Tarnby assembly?
options: Its proposal was largely accepted by the council.
It heard evidence from engineers and local businesses.
It recommended a smaller road and more buses.
Its members were chosen by lottery.
Its members were paid a fee for attending.
exercises.explanation: Üyelere ücret ödendiğine dair bilgi metinde yoktur → 'Its members were paid a fee …' cevaptır. Kurayla seçim, mühendisleri ve işletmeleri dinleme, küçük yol ile otobüs önerisi ve önerinin neredeyse aynen kabulü metinde açıkça geçer.

exercises.passage: Historians have traditionally explained the decline of the fictional port of Saltmere in the seventeenth century by the silting of its harbour, which made it impossible for larger ships to dock. Recently discovered customs records, however, suggest that this account is at best incomplete. The records show that trade through Saltmere had begun to fall nearly thirty years before the harbour became unusable, at a time when a rival port further along the coast had abolished its import taxes. Merchants, it seems, were already moving their business elsewhere. The silting may well have finished Saltmere off, but it was arguably the final blow rather than the original cause. Some historians remain unconvinced, however. They note that customs records from this period are often unreliable, since merchants frequently avoided declaring their goods in order to pay less tax, and that a fall in recorded trade may therefore reflect smuggling rather than a genuine decline.
exercises.question: The author's main purpose in the passage is to ----.
options: prove that silting played no part in Saltmere's decline
show how new evidence has challenged a traditional explanation
compare the trade of two ports in the twentieth century
describe the engineering methods used to clear silted harbours
explain how merchants avoided paying import taxes
exercises.explanation: Metin geleneksel açıklamayı (limanın dolması) yeni gümrük kayıtlarıyla sorgular ve karşı görüşü de aktarır → 'show how new evidence has challenged a traditional explanation'. 'Prove that silting played no part' aşırı genellemedir; yazar dolmanın *final blow* olabileceğini kabul eder.

exercises.passage: Historians have traditionally explained the decline of the fictional port of Saltmere in the seventeenth century by the silting of its harbour, which made it impossible for larger ships to dock. Recently discovered customs records, however, suggest that this account is at best incomplete. The records show that trade through Saltmere had begun to fall nearly thirty years before the harbour became unusable, at a time when a rival port further along the coast had abolished its import taxes. Merchants, it seems, were already moving their business elsewhere. The silting may well have finished Saltmere off, but it was arguably the final blow rather than the original cause. Some historians remain unconvinced, however. They note that customs records from this period are often unreliable, since merchants frequently avoided declaring their goods in order to pay less tax, and that a fall in recorded trade may therefore reflect smuggling rather than a genuine decline.
exercises.question: It can be understood from the passage that some historians remain unconvinced because ----.
options: the harbour of Saltmere did not in fact silt up
the customs records were discovered too recently to be read
the drop in recorded trade might be explained by smuggling
Saltmere's trade increased after the harbour closed
the rival port never actually abolished its import taxes
exercises.explanation: Şüpheci tarihçilere göre tüccarlar mallarını beyan etmekten kaçındığı için kayıtlardaki düşüş gerçek bir gerilemeyi değil kaçakçılığı yansıtıyor olabilir → 'the drop in recorded trade might be explained by smuggling'. 'The harbour … did not in fact silt up' kimsenin ileri sürmediği bir iddiadır; iki taraf da limanın dolduğunu kabul eder.

nodes.title: Karışık zor set
nodes.description: Tüm soru türlerinden sınav düzeyinde birer soru: kelime, dilbilgisi, cloze, çeviri, okuma, diyalog ve paragraf

exercises.question: The committee's report was ---- critical of the ministry, describing its handling of the crisis as a catalogue of avoidable errors.
exercises.explanation: *a catalogue of avoidable errors* çok sert bir eleştiridir → 'scathingly'. 'Marginally' (çok az) ve 'tentatively' (çekinerek) bu sert ifadeyle çelişir; 'sympathetically' anlayışlı bir tutum bildirir.

exercises.question: Had the researchers controlled for family income in the original study, they ---- a much weaker link between breakfast and test scores.
exercises.explanation: *Had + özne + V3* devrik üçüncü tip koşuldur (geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş durum) → 'would have found'. 'Had found' sonuç kısmında kullanılamaz; 'will find' birinci tip koşula aittir.

exercises.question: Research over the past three decades suggests that the cognitive advantages of bilingualism are smaller than early studies claimed and depend ---- the age at which the second language is acquired.
exercises.explanation: *depend on* sabit bir kalıptır → 'on'. 'Depend from' ve 'depend with' İngilizcede yoktur; 'At' ve 'for' da *depend* ile kalıp oluşturmaz; Türkçedeki '-e bağlı' yapısı adayı yanlış edat aramaya itebilir.

exercises.question: ----, the new congestion charge has so far failed to reduce the number of cars entering the city centre.
options: So that drivers could park more easily
Since fewer cars have entered the city centre than in any previous year
Although it was introduced with considerable public support
Unless it is enforced more strictly
If it had been designed by the council
exercises.explanation: Ana cümle bir başarısızlık bildirir; zıtlık kuran 'Although it was introduced with considerable public support' anlamlıdır. 'Since fewer cars have entered' ana cümleyle çelişir; 'Unless it is enforced …' koşul bildirir, ama *has so far failed* geçmişe dönük bir tespittir.

exercises.question: Bulguların genellenip genellenemeyeceği, örneklemin yalnızca üniversite öğrencilerinden oluşması nedeniyle belirsizliğini korumaktadır.
options: It is clear that the findings can be generalised to university students only.
Whether the findings can be generalised remains unclear because the sample consisted only of university students.
The sample consisted only of university students, so the findings were never generalised.
The findings cannot be generalised, although the sample consisted only of university students.
Because the findings were generalised, the sample was limited to university students.
exercises.explanation: 'Genellenip genellenemeyeceği' → *whether … can be generalised*; 'belirsizliğini korumaktadır' → *remains unclear*; 'nedeniyle' → *because* → 'Whether the findings can be generalised remains unclear …'. 'The findings cannot be generalised, although …' belirsizliği kesinliğe çevirir ve neden bağını zıtlığa dönüştürür.

exercises.passage: Urban red foxes in the fictional city of Hollin have become noticeably bolder over the past twenty years. To find out why, a team of zoologists compared the behaviour of city foxes with that of foxes living in the surrounding countryside by placing unfamiliar food containers in both environments. City foxes approached the containers far more quickly, yet they were no better than rural foxes at actually opening them. The researchers conclude that urban life seems to have reduced the animals' fear of new objects rather than improved their problem-solving abilities. This distinction, they argue, matters because popular accounts often describe city wildlife as smarter than its rural relatives, a claim their data do not support. Interestingly, the individuals that eventually opened the containers in both groups were those that kept trying the longest, which suggests that persistence, rather than boldness, is what finally pays off. The team now plans to study fox cubs raised in captivity to test whether these differences are inherited or learned.
exercises.question: The researchers would most likely disagree with the view that ----.
options: city foxes approach unfamiliar objects more quickly than rural foxes
urban life can change the behaviour of wild animals
city foxes are more intelligent than foxes living in the countryside
living in cities can reduce animals' fear of new objects
further research is needed on fox cubs raised in captivity
exercises.explanation: Araştırmacılar kent tilkilerinin *smarter* olduğu iddiasını verilerinin desteklemediğini açıkça söyler → 'city foxes are more intelligent than foxes living in the countryside'. 'Approach unfamiliar objects more quickly' ve 'reduce animals' fear' araştırmacıların kendi bulgularıdır; bunlara karşı çıkmaları beklenmez.

exercises.passage:
Ayla: I finished the reading section of the mock exam in thirty minutes, but I got six questions wrong.
Tutor: ----
Ayla: You're right. I think I rushed the inference questions without checking the passage carefully.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Did you take the mock exam at home or at a test centre?
Thirty minutes is far too long for the reading section.
Then you should skip the reading section entirely next time and focus on the grammar questions.
Perhaps you could afford to spend a few more minutes on each passage.
Inference questions never appear in the real exam.
exercises.explanation: Ayla *You're right … I rushed* diyerek acele ettiğini kabul eder; demek ki öğretmen daha fazla zaman ayırmasını önermiştir → 'Perhaps you could afford to spend a few more minutes on each passage.' 'Thirty minutes is far too long' tam tersini söyler ve *I rushed* ile çelişir; 'skip the reading section entirely' mantıksız bir öneridir.

exercises.question: Only when the results had been replicated by an independent team did the journal agree to publish the study. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: The journal agreed to publish the study, although the results had not been replicated.
An independent team refused to replicate the results because the journal had published the study.
Because the journal had published the study, the results were replicated by an independent team.
The journal published the study, after which an independent team replicated the results.
The journal did not agree to publish the study until an independent team had replicated the results.
exercises.explanation: *Only when … did* = 'ancak … olduğunda'; yani sonuçlar bağımsız bir ekipçe tekrar elde edilmeden yayın kabul edilmedi → 'The journal did not agree to publish the study until an independent team had replicated the results.' 'The journal published the study, after which …' olayların sırasını tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: Many readers assume that a confident tone indicates a reliable argument. ---- Academic writers, in fact, often signal their reliability precisely by acknowledging limitations, using phrases such as 'the data suggest' or 'it remains unclear whether'. A text full of words like 'undeniably' and 'proves', by contrast, may be hiding weak evidence behind strong language.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Yet the relationship is frequently the reverse.
For this reason, words such as 'proves' are banned in academic writing.
This is why most academic journals reject cautious articles.
As a result, readers rarely notice the tone of a text.
Confident writers usually publish more books than cautious ones.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki cümle güvenilir yazarların sınırlılıkları kabul ettiğini, yani kendinden emin tonun güvenilirlik göstermediğini söyler; önceki varsayımı tersine çeviren 'Yet the relationship is frequently the reverse.' gerekir. 'Words such as proves are banned' aşırı genellemedir; son cümle bu kelimelerin kullanıldığını söyler.

exercises.passage: (I) Rising sea temperatures have been linked to a decline in kelp forests along the fictional Varne coast. (II) Kelp provides shelter and food for hundreds of species, including several commercially important fish. (III) As the forests have shrunk, local fishermen have reported smaller catches of these species. (IV) Kelp is also used in some cosmetics, where it is valued for its smooth texture. (V) Marine biologists warn that, without intervention, the decline could soon affect the entire coastal food web.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf yosun ormanlarının azalmasını ve bunun ekosisteme, balıkçılığa etkisini anlatır. IV. cümle yosunun kozmetikte kullanımına geçer; konu (kelp) ortak olsa da akışı (azalma ve sonuçları) bozar. Tuzak: aynı anahtar kelimeyi taşıyan cümle ilk bakışta uyumlu görünür.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 20 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: Although the two reports were based on the same data, there was a striking ---- between their conclusions, which neither author could explain.
exercises.explanation: *Although … the same data* aynı veriden farklı sonuç çıktığını ima eder; *which neither author could explain* da açıklanamayan bir farkı gösterir → 'discrepancy'. 'Consensus' (fikir birliği) zıt anlamdır; aynı veriden aynı sonuca ulaşmak açıklama gerektirmez.

exercises.question: The minister tried to ---- the significance of the leaked report, calling it a minor administrative matter.
exercises.explanation: Raporu 'küçük bir idari mesele' diye nitelemek önemini küçültmektir → 'downplay'. 'Underline' (vurgulamak) ve 'bolster' (güçlendirmek) zıt yöndedir; 'acclaim' övmek demektir.

exercises.question: The results were so inconsistent ---- the team had to repeat the entire experiment.
exercises.explanation: *so + sıfat + that* sonuç bildiren kalıptır → 'that'. 'As' ve 'than' karşılaştırma yapılarında kullanılır; 'which' ilgi zamiri olarak burada bir isim nitelemez.

exercises.question: Not until the customs records were examined ---- that the port's trade had begun to decline decades earlier.
exercises.explanation: Cümle başındaki *Not until …* ana cümlede devrik yapı ister: yardımcı fiil + özne + fiil → 'did historians realise'. 'Historians realised' devrik değildir; 'do historians realise' zaman bakımından geçmişle uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage: Citizen science projects, in which volunteers collect data for professional researchers, have expanded rapidly in recent years. (1) ---- their popularity, such projects have often been viewed with suspicion by scientists, who worry about the quality of data gathered by untrained people. A recent review, however, found that volunteer data were (2) ---- accurate as professional data when participants received clear instructions and simple tools. The review also stressed that the main benefit of these projects may lie (3) ---- their ability to raise public interest in science.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: Projeler popülerdir ama bilim insanları onlara şüpheyle bakar; zıtlık gerekir → 'Despite'. 'Because of' ve 'Owing to' neden bildirir; popülerlik şüphenin nedeni değildir.

exercises.passage: Citizen science projects, in which volunteers collect data for professional researchers, have expanded rapidly in recent years. (1) ---- their popularity, such projects have often been viewed with suspicion by scientists, who worry about the quality of data gathered by untrained people. A recent review, however, found that volunteer data were (2) ---- accurate as professional data when participants received clear instructions and simple tools. The review also stressed that the main benefit of these projects may lie (3) ---- their ability to raise public interest in science.
exercises.question: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki *accurate as* eşitlik karşılaştırmasının ikinci yarısıdır: *as … as* → 'as'. 'More' *than* ister; 'so … as' yalnızca olumsuz cümlelerde kullanılır.

exercises.passage: Citizen science projects, in which volunteers collect data for professional researchers, have expanded rapidly in recent years. (1) ---- their popularity, such projects have often been viewed with suspicion by scientists, who worry about the quality of data gathered by untrained people. A recent review, however, found that volunteer data were (2) ---- accurate as professional data when participants received clear instructions and simple tools. The review also stressed that the main benefit of these projects may lie (3) ---- their ability to raise public interest in science.
exercises.question: (3) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: *lie in* = '-de yatmak, -den kaynaklanmak' kalıbıdır → 'in'. 'Lie on' fiziksel olarak bir şeyin üstünde yatmak demektir; 'lie with' sorumluluğun birine ait olduğunu bildirir.

exercises.question: The museum's new audio guide attracted more visitors, ----.
options: unless printed labels are restored in every gallery
as if the galleries had been closed for years
so that older visitors could read the information at their own pace
but it did not encourage them to spend longer in the galleries
exercises.explanation: Ana cümle olumlu bir sonuç verir; *but* ile gelen beklenmedik olumsuz sonuç anlamlıdır → 'but it did not encourage them to spend longer in the galleries'. 'Because nobody downloaded the app' ziyaretçi artışını açıklayamaz; 'unless …' zaman ve mantık bakımından uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: Provided that participants receive clear instructions, ----.
options: scientists were suspicious of citizen science projects
volunteers can collect data almost as reliable as those of professionals
the review would have found serious errors in the data they collected last year
untrained people had been excluded from the project
the data was collected by professional researchers only
exercises.explanation: *Provided that* (şartıyla) birinci tip koşul gibi şimdiki ya da genel bir sonuç ister → 'volunteers can collect data almost as reliable as those of professionals'. 'Would have found' üçüncü tip koşula aittir; 'had been excluded' de zaman uyumsuzluğu taşır.

exercises.question: ----, the study's authors refused to draw firm conclusions about the policy.
options: Unless the savings had been greater than expected
As soon as the policy is introduced
So that the policy could be adopted nationwide as quickly as possible
In case teachers valued the extra day
Because the effects varied so widely from one school to another
exercises.explanation: Kesin sonuç çıkarmamanın mantıklı nedeni etkilerin okuldan okula çok değişmesidir → 'Because the effects varied so widely from one school to another'. 'So that the policy could be adopted nationwide' amaç bildirir ve kesin sonuçtan kaçınmayla çelişir; 'As soon as … is introduced' zaman bakımından uyumsuzdur.

exercises.question: The researchers do not claim that hedgerows reduce pest outbreaks; they merely suggest that the two may be connected.
options: Araştırmacılara göre çitler zararlı salgınlarını azaltmaz, ama ikisi kesinlikle bağlantılıdır.
Araştırmacılar çitlerin zararlı salgınlarını azalttığını iddia etmiyor; yalnızca ikisinin bağlantılı olabileceğini öne sürüyorlar.
Araştırmacılar, çitler zararlı salgınlarını azaltmadığı için ikisinin bağlantısız olduğunu öne sürüyor.
Araştırmacılar çitlerin zararlı salgınlarını azalttığını kesin olarak kanıtlamış ve ikisinin doğrudan bağlantılı olduğunu açıkça göstermiştir.
Araştırmacılar çitlerin zararlı salgınlarını artırdığını iddia ediyor, ancak bunun kanıtı yoktur.
exercises.explanation: *do not claim* → 'iddia etmiyor'; *merely suggest* → 'yalnızca öne sürüyorlar'; *may be connected* → 'bağlantılı olabileceğini'. Doğru cevap '… iddia etmiyor; yalnızca ikisinin bağlantılı olabileceğini öne sürüyorlar.' 'Kanıtlamış' diyen çeviri temkinli ifadeyi kesinliğe çevirir; 'kesinlikle bağlantılıdır' diyen de *may* kipini atlar.

exercises.question: Yeni kanıtlar geleneksel açıklamayı tamamen çürütmese de onun ciddi biçimde sorgulanmasına yol açmıştır.
options: Even though the new evidence does not completely refute the traditional explanation, it has caused it to be seriously called into question.
The traditional explanation has completely refuted the new evidence, which is now being questioned.
The new evidence has not been seriously questioned, although it refutes the traditional explanation.
Because the new evidence completely refutes the traditional explanation, nobody questions it any longer, even among the experts who first proposed it.
Unless the new evidence refutes the traditional explanation, it will not be called into question.
exercises.explanation: 'Çürütmese de' → *Even though … does not completely refute*; 'sorgulanmasına yol açmıştır' → *has caused it to be seriously called into question*. 'Because the new evidence completely refutes …' olumsuzluğu atar; 'The traditional explanation has completely refuted the new evidence' özne ile nesnenin yerini değiştirir.

exercises.passage: Over the past decade, standing desks have been promoted as a simple remedy for the health risks of office work. A study carried out at the fictional Brevik Insurance Group set out to test this claim. Half of the company's 240 office staff were given adjustable desks, while the other half kept their ordinary ones. After a year, the standing-desk group did spend, on average, about seventy minutes less per day sitting. However, there was no measurable difference between the groups in weight, blood pressure or reported back pain. Interestingly, many employees in the standing-desk group stopped using the standing position after the first three months, complaining of tired legs. The authors suggest that standing in one place is not the same as moving, and that the real health benefits of reducing sitting time may come only when it is replaced by walking or other light activity. They acknowledge, however, that a single year may be too short to detect long-term effects, and that their participants, being relatively young, may not have been at high risk to begin with. They are therefore cautious about drawing firm conclusions either for or against the desks.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the standing-desk group ----.
options: used the standing position consistently throughout the year
walked for more than seventy minutes a day
sat for less time each day but showed no clear improvement in health
reported more back pain than the other group
lost more weight than the employees who continued to work at ordinary desks
exercises.explanation: Grup günde yaklaşık 70 dakika daha az oturdu, ama kilo, tansiyon ve bel ağrısında fark yoktu → 'sat for less time each day but showed no clear improvement in health'. 'Walked for more than seventy minutes' sayıyı yanlış bağlamda kullanır (70 dakika daha az oturma, yürüme değil); 'consistently throughout the year' metinle çelişir, çoğu üç ay sonra bıraktı.

exercises.passage: Over the past decade, standing desks have been promoted as a simple remedy for the health risks of office work. A study carried out at the fictional Brevik Insurance Group set out to test this claim. Half of the company's 240 office staff were given adjustable desks, while the other half kept their ordinary ones. After a year, the standing-desk group did spend, on average, about seventy minutes less per day sitting. However, there was no measurable difference between the groups in weight, blood pressure or reported back pain. Interestingly, many employees in the standing-desk group stopped using the standing position after the first three months, complaining of tired legs. The authors suggest that standing in one place is not the same as moving, and that the real health benefits of reducing sitting time may come only when it is replaced by walking or other light activity. They acknowledge, however, that a single year may be too short to detect long-term effects, and that their participants, being relatively young, may not have been at high risk to begin with. They are therefore cautious about drawing firm conclusions either for or against the desks.
exercises.question: The authors would most likely agree that ----.
options: the study proves that sitting has no effect on health
standing desks are harmful to the health of office workers
older employees should never use standing desks
a desk that led employees to walk more might bring greater benefits than one used only for standing
seventy minutes of standing a day is enough to prevent back pain and most other health problems linked to office work
exercises.explanation: Yazarlar asıl faydanın oturma süresinin yürüme ya da hafif hareketle değiştirilmesinden gelebileceğini söyler → 'a desk that led employees to walk more might bring greater benefits than one used only for standing'. 'The study proves that sitting has no effect' aşırı genellemedir; yazarlar kesin sonuçtan kaçınır.

exercises.passage: Over the past decade, standing desks have been promoted as a simple remedy for the health risks of office work. A study carried out at the fictional Brevik Insurance Group set out to test this claim. They are therefore cautious about drawing firm conclusions either for or against the desks.
exercises.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage?
options: The study lasted for one year.
Some employees complained of tired legs.
Staff were paid a bonus to take part.
Half of the staff received adjustable desks.
exercises.explanation: Katılım için ikramiye ödendiği metinde geçmez → 'Staff were paid a bonus …' cevaptır. Çalışanların yarısına ayarlanabilir masa verilmesi, yorgun bacak şikâyeti, katılımcıların görece genç olması ve çalışmanın bir yıl sürmesi metinde vardır.

exercises.question: The authors' overall conclusion can best be described as ----.
options: strongly in favour of standing desks
certain that standing desks are useless
exercises.explanation: Yazarlar sınırlılıkları kabul eder ve *cautious about drawing firm conclusions either for or against the desks* der → 'balanced and cautious'. 'Certain that standing desks are useless' ve 'strongly in favour' iki uçtaki aşırı şıklardır; metin ikisinden de kaçınır.

exercises.passage:
Emre: I've decided to stop doing full mock exams and just practise grammar until the test.
Selin: ----
Emre: Maybe, but I lose so much time on the reading passages that I panic.
Selin: Then that's exactly why you need the full exams. The panic only goes away with practice.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Isn't that risky? Reading makes up a quarter of the exam.
I took the exam last year and passed easily.
Reading passages are always shorter than grammar questions.
How many grammar books have you bought so far?
Good idea. Grammar is the only section that really matters.
exercises.explanation: Emre'nin *Maybe, but I lose so much time on the reading passages* cevabı, kendisine okumayla ilgili bir itiraz yapıldığını gösterir → 'Isn't that risky? Reading makes up a quarter of the exam.' 'Good idea …' Emre'yi onaylar; o zaman *Maybe, but* ile karşı çıkması anlamsız olur.

exercises.question: The policy's success appears to depend less on the number of school days than on how the free day is used. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: Neither the number of school days nor the use of the free day affects the policy.
The number of school days is the only factor that determines the policy's success.
How the free day is used seems to matter more for the policy's success than the number of school days.
Since every school uses the free day in exactly the same way, the number of school days is what matters most.
The policy succeeded because the number of school days was reduced.
exercises.explanation: *depend less on X than on Y* = Y, X'ten daha önemlidir → 'How the free day is used seems to matter more … than the number of school days.' 'The number of school days is the only factor' karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir ve *only* ile aşırı genelleme yapar; *appears* kipinin karşılığı *seems* doğru şıkta korunmuştur.

exercises.passage: Some readers find questions about an author's attitude the hardest part of reading tests. ---- Instead, attitude is usually revealed indirectly, through words such as 'admittedly', 'at best' or 'surprisingly', and through what the author chooses to emphasise. Learning to notice these signals can turn attitude questions from guesswork into a matter of careful reading.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Authors always express their opinions in the first sentence.
Such readers usually finish the test earlier than others.
Vocabulary questions, by contrast, require a very large vocabulary.
Most tests therefore no longer include attitude questions.
This is partly because writers rarely state their opinions openly.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki *Instead, attitude is usually revealed indirectly* cümlesi, önce görüşün açıkça belirtilmediğinin söylenmesini gerektirir → 'This is partly because writers rarely state their opinions openly.' 'Authors always express their opinions in the first sentence' sonraki cümleyle çelişir; 'Vocabulary questions …' konuyu değiştirir.

exercises.passage: (I) The fictional Lake Orvin has lost nearly half of its surface area since 1980. (II) Most of the decline is due to farms upstream diverting water from the rivers that feed the lake. (III) The lake was named after a nineteenth-century surveyor who first mapped the region. (IV) As the water has retreated, dust from the exposed lakebed has begun to affect the health of nearby villagers. (V) Regional authorities have now proposed limiting the amount of water that farms may take from the rivers.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf gölün küçülmesini, nedenini, sonucunu ve önerilen çözümü sırayla anlatır. III. cümle gölün adının kökenine geçer ve neden-sonuç zincirini böler. Tuzak: göl ve bölge sözcükleri ortak olduğu için cümle konu dışı görünmez; ama akışın alt konusuna (küçülme) katkısı yoktur.

nodes.title: Tam deneme 7
