units.title: Deneme haftası 5: son prova
units.description: Tam Deneme 8'e hazırlık: diyalog, restatement, paragraf tamamlama, anlam bütünlüğü ve karışık zor sorular; hedef 72+ (90 puan)
units.guide:
## Önceki denemenin hata analizi
Tam Deneme 7'nin sonuçlarını tür bazında yaz ve okumada 16/20 hedefini tutturup tutturmadığına bak. 72 doğru için **kayıp bütçen 8 yanlıştır**. Bütçeyi aşan türü bul: genellikle okuma (aşırı genelleme şıkları) ya da diyalog (boşluktan sonraki repliğe bakmamak) olur. Son bölümdeki 18 soruda (diyalog, restatement, paragraf tamamlama, anlam bütünlüğü) kaybın 2'yi geçtiyse bu hafta en hızlı puan oradan gelir; bu sorular kısa ve kurala dayalıdır.

## Bu haftanın hedefi
Tam Deneme 8'de hedef **72+ doğru = 90 puan**. Tür bazında hedef: kelime 5/6, dilbilgisi 9/10, cloze 9/10, cümle tamamlama 9/10, çeviri 6/6, okuma 16/20, diyalog 5/6, restatement 3/3, paragraf tamamlama 4/4, anlam bütünlüğü 5/5. Bu tablo toplamda 71 eder; **72 için bir türde bir fazla gerekir**: en gerçekçisi okuma 17/20 ya da kelime 6/6. Bu bir güvenlik payıdır.

## Strateji
- **Diyalog:** Anahtar, boşluktan **sonraki** repliktir. Soruya cevap, cevaba soru, itiraza gerekçe gelir. *Neither do I* gibi kısa tepkiler önceki cümlenin olumlu ya da olumsuz olduğunu ele verir.
- **Restatement:** Anlamın aynısını ara. Zaman, olumsuzluk (*hardly, not until*), koşul (*had it not been for*) ve karşılaştırma yönü (*less … than*) korunmalıdır.
- **Paragraf tamamlama:** Boşluğun önü ve arkası ile bağ kur: zamirler (*this, such, those cases*), bağlaçlar (*however, instead*) ve konu.
- **Anlam bütünlüğü:** Konuyu değil, **akışı** bozan cümleyi bul. Çoğu zaman aynı anahtar kelimeyi taşır ama başka bir alt konuya geçer.

## Örnekler
- *Hardly any candidates finished on time.* — Neredeyse hiçbir aday zamanında bitiremedi. (= *Very few candidates …*)
- *Had it not been for the scholarship, he could not have studied abroad.* — Burs olmasaydı yurt dışında okuyamazdı. (= *only because he received the scholarship*)
- *In those cases, the report tends to confirm …* — Boşluktan sonraki *those cases* önceki cümlede belirli durumların anlatıldığını gösterir.

## Nasıl çözülür
1. Diyalogda önce boşluktan sonraki repliği oku; ne tür bir cümleye tepki verdiğini belirle (soru, öneri, itiraz, olumsuz cümle).
2. Restatement'ta kök cümlenin dört işaretini çiz: zaman, olumsuzluk, koşul, derece. Bunlardan birini değiştiren şıkkı ele.
3. Paragraf tamamlamada boşluğa aday cümleyi yerleştirip önceki ve sonraki cümleyle birlikte sessizce oku; zamir ve bağlaç boşta kalıyorsa ele.
4. Anlam bütünlüğünde ilk cümleden paragrafın alt konusunu çıkar; her cümleye "bu, alt konuyu ilerletiyor mu?" diye sor.

**Örnek:** *Deniz: Are you going to the revision session? / Mert: ---- / Deniz: Neither do I, but missing it might be a mistake.* Adım 1: *Neither do I* olumsuz ve geniş zamanlı bir cümleye tepkidir → 'I don't really feel like it, to be honest.' 'I can't decide whether to go' olumsuzdur ama *Neither can I* gerektirir; 'Yes, I've already registered' olumludur, elenir.

## Tuzaklar ve sık yapılan hatalar
- **Diyalogda yalnızca önceki repliğe bakmak:** Türk adaylar soruya "mantıklı" bir cevap seçer; ama sonraki replikle bağ kurmayan şık yanlıştır.
- **Restatement'ta kelime avı:** Aynı kelimeleri taşıyan şık anlamı tersine çevirmiş olabilir (*not until* → *only after* doğru; *before* yanlış).
- **Paragraf tamamlamada genel doğruya kanmak:** Kendi başına doğru ama zamiri ya da bağlacı boşta kalan cümle tuzaktır.
- **Anlam bütünlüğünde ilk ve son cümleyi elemek:** Bozan cümle çoğu zaman II–IV arasındadır, ama V de olabilir.

## Sınav ipucu
**Sınav haftası planı:** 6 gün kala Tam Deneme 8'i sınav saatinde, 180 dakikada çöz. 5–4 gün kala hata defteri ve zayıf türden 20'şer soru. 3 gün kala kelime listelerini tekrar et, yarım deneme çözme. 2 gün kala belgelerini (sınav giriş belgesi, geçerli kimlik) hazırla, sınav binasının yerini öğren. 1 gün kala yeni konu yok; 30 dakika kelime, hafif yürüyüş, erken uyku.

**Sınav günü planı:** Hafif kahvaltı, su; binada en az 45 dakika önce ol. Süre bütçesi (180 dk): kelime ve dilbilgisi 20 dk, cloze 15 dk, cümle tamamlama 15 dk, çeviri 15 dk, okuma 40 dk, diyalog ve restatement 20 dk, paragraf tamamlama ve anlam bütünlüğü 20 dk, kalan 35 dk işaretli sorular ve cevap kâğıdı kontrolü. Bir soruda 2 dakikayı geçince işaretle ve geç; ilk cevabını açık bir kanıt olmadan değiştirme.

nodes.title: Son haftanın kelimeleri
nodes.description: Diyalog kalıpları, bağlaçlar ve sınav haftası kelimeleri

exercises.question: The speaker began to ---- from the main topic, telling long stories about his childhood.
exercises.explanation: Ana konudan uzaklaşıp çocukluk anılarına geçmek konudan sapmaktır; *digress from* kalıbı → 'digress'. 'Summarise' (özetlemek) ana konuya bağlı kalır ve *from* ile kullanılmaz; 'reassure' birini rahatlatmak demektir.

exercises.question: The exam ---- has been changed, so check the new address on your entrance document.
exercises.explanation: Adresi değişen şey sınav yeridir → 'venue'. 'Setback' (aksilik) ve 'pitfall' (tuzak) bir adrese sahip olamaz; 'stamina' dayanıklılık demektir.

exercises.text: In the last week, ___ your mistake notebook instead of starting new topics.
exercises.translation: Son haftada yeni konulara başlamak yerine hata defterini gözden geçir.

exercises.question: Many candidates lose points not because they lack knowledge but because they work at too fast ---- and misread the questions.
exercises.explanation: *work at a … pace* = 'bir hızda çalışmak'; *too fast* hızı niteler → 'a pace'. 'A hunch' (önsezi) hızlı olamaz; 'stationery' sayılamayan bir isimdir ve *a* almaz.

exercises.question: Choosing an answer on a mere ---- is risky; look for evidence in the text instead.
exercises.explanation: Kanıt yerine dayanılan şey önseziyle tahmindir → 'hunch'. 'Rehearsal' (prova) ve 'venue' (mekân) bir cevabın dayanağı olamaz; *instead* kanıtın karşıtını ister.

exercises.question: Despite failing her first mock exam, she proved remarkably ----, improving her score by twenty points within a month.
exercises.explanation: Başarısızlıktan sonra bir ayda 20 puan artırmak çabuk toparlanmayı gösterir → 'resilient'. 'Hesitant' (tereddütlü) bu hızlı ilerlemeyle uyuşmaz; 'inconvenient' insanı değil durumu niteler.

exercises.question: The tutor was ---- that the students should take one final full mock exam, and refused to let anyone skip it.
exercises.explanation: *refused to let anyone skip it* kesin ve ısrarcı bir tutumu gösterir → 'adamant'. 'Hesitant' (tereddütlü) cümlenin ikinci yarısıyla çelişir; 'apologetic' özür diler tavır demektir.

exercises.question: There is ---- between speed and accuracy: the faster you answer, the more careless mistakes you are likely to make.
exercises.explanation: Birinden kazanırken ötekinden kaybetmek ödünleşimdir → 'a trade-off'. 'A setback' tek bir aksiliktir, iki şey arasındaki dengeyi anlatmaz; 'a warm-up' ısınma demektir.

exercises.text: Don't ___ your first answer unless you find clear evidence that it is wrong.
exercises.translation: Yanlış olduğuna dair açık bir kanıt bulmadıkça ilk cevabından şüphe edip onu değiştirme.

exercises.question: In the final week, focus on revising what you already know, ---- trying to learn large amounts of new material, which only increases anxiety.
exercises.explanation: Cümle eski bilgiyi tekrar etmeyi yeni bilgi öğrenmenin karşısına koyar (*which only increases anxiety*) → 'as opposed to'. 'Not to mention' ve 'alongside' yeni konu çalışmayı da önerir ve cümlenin sonuyla çelişir; 'let alone' olumsuz bir cümle ister.

nodes.title: Diyalog, restatement ve paragraf
nodes.description: Son bölümün dört soru türü: orta düzeyde, kural odaklı alıştırma

exercises.passage:
Customer: I booked a double room for three nights, but the receipt shows four.
Receptionist: ----
Customer: Yes, I checked out this morning, so it should be three.
Receptionist: You're right. I'll correct it and refund the difference.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: How did you hear about our hotel?
I'm sorry about that. Did you check out today rather than tomorrow?
I'm afraid our receipts are always correct.
Our hotel has no double rooms available this week.
Would you like to book another night with us at a special discount rate?
exercises.explanation: Müşterinin *Yes, I checked out this morning* cevabı, çıkış tarihinin sorulduğunu gösterir → 'I'm sorry about that. Did you check out today rather than tomorrow?' 'I'm afraid our receipts are always correct' görevlinin son repliğindeki *You're right* ile çelişir; 'Would you like to book another night' çıkış yapmış bir müşteriye uymaz.

exercises.passage:
Lecturer: Your essay makes some interesting points, but the conclusion seems to come from nowhere.
Student: ----
Lecturer: Exactly. You need a paragraph that links your evidence to the final argument.
Student: I see. I'll add one before I hand it in again.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: So you mean the essay is missing a step between the evidence and the conclusion?
Could I hand it in two weeks late?
Thank you, I'm glad you liked the conclusion so much.
I wrote the conclusion first and the introduction last, just as you suggested in class.
Which library did you use for your research?
exercises.explanation: Öğretim üyesinin *Exactly. You need a paragraph that links your evidence to the final argument* cevabı, öğrencinin eleştiriyi kendi sözleriyle doğrulamaya çalıştığını gösterir → 'So you mean the essay is missing a step …?' 'I'm glad you liked the conclusion' eleştiriyi övgü sanar; 'Which library …' soruyu öğrenci değil hoca sorar.

exercises.passage:
Deniz: Are you going to the revision session on Saturday?
Mert: ----
Deniz: Neither do I, but missing it might be a mistake. They're going over the irrelevant-sentence questions.
Mert: In that case, I'll come along.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Did you finish the mock exam yesterday?
I can't decide whether to go or not.
Yes, I've already registered for it.
I don't really feel like it, to be honest.
exercises.explanation: *Neither do I* olumsuz ve geniş zamanlı bir cümleye verilen tepkidir → 'I don't really feel like it, to be honest.' 'I can't decide …' de olumsuzdur ama *Neither can I* gerektirir; 'Yes, I've already registered' olumludur ve *Neither* ile uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: Hardly any of the candidates finished the reading section within the recommended time. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: Very few candidates completed the reading section in the time recommended.
Most of the candidates finished the reading section earlier than recommended.
Almost all candidates found the reading section easy.
The recommended time for the reading section was too long for most candidates.
None of the candidates attempted the reading section.
exercises.explanation: *Hardly any* = 'neredeyse hiçbiri' → 'Very few candidates completed the reading section in the time recommended.' 'None of the candidates attempted …' aşırı genellemedir (hiç denemediler demek başka bir anlamdır); 'Most of the candidates finished …' olumsuzluğu atar.

exercises.question: The more questions you practise under timed conditions, the less likely you are to panic on the day of the exam. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: If you practise too many timed questions, you will panic on exam day.
Panicking on exam day is unavoidable, however many questions you practise.
You should not practise questions under timed conditions the day before the exam, as it causes unnecessary stress.
Practising more questions under timed conditions reduces the chance that you will panic on exam day.
Timed practice is less useful than untimed practice for preventing panic.
exercises.explanation: *The more …, the less …* artan pratiğin paniği azalttığını söyler → 'Practising more questions under timed conditions reduces the chance that you will panic on exam day.' 'If you practise too many …, you will panic' ilişkiyi tersine çevirir; 'unavoidable' kök cümleyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Vending machines selling fresh fruit were installed in several schools in the fictional town of Melby. ---- Sales of crisps and chocolate in the same schools, on the other hand, barely changed. The organisers now believe that offering healthy food is not enough unless unhealthy options also become less convenient.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: As a result, sales of crisps and chocolate fell sharply.
Most pupils in Melby walk to school.
Unhealthy food, however, was removed from all the schools.
Within a few months, fruit sales had risen steadily.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki *Sales of crisps and chocolate …, on the other hand, barely changed* önce meyve satışlarıyla ilgili olumlu bir sonuç bekler → 'Within a few months, fruit sales had risen steadily.' 'Sales of crisps and chocolate fell sharply' sonraki cümleyle çelişir; 'Unhealthy food … was removed' son cümledeki öneriyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage: ---- Some languages, for instance, have no separate words for blue and green, and their speakers describe both colours with a single term. Yet experiments show that these speakers can still tell the two colours apart when asked to compare them side by side. Language, in other words, may influence how we categorise colours without limiting what we are able to see.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: All languages have exactly the same number of colour words.
Languages differ considerably in how they divide up the colour spectrum.
Colour blindness is more common among men than among women.
Most people find it difficult to learn a second language after the age of twelve.
Speakers of these languages are unable to see the difference between blue and green.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümle *for instance* ile bazı dillerde mavi ve yeşil için ayrı kelime olmadığını örnekler; boşluk bu örneğin genel fikrini vermelidir → 'Languages differ considerably in how they divide up the colour spectrum.' 'All languages have exactly the same number of colour words' örnekle çelişir; 'unable to see the difference' paragrafın sonucuyla çelişir.

exercises.passage: Many students believe that rereading their notes is the most effective way to prepare for an exam. Research, however, consistently points in a different direction. ---- When students attempt to recall information from memory, by answering practice questions for example, they remember it far longer than when they simply read it again.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Rereading notes several times is therefore highly recommended.
Exams are usually held at the end of the academic year.
Testing oneself appears to be considerably more effective than rereading.
Most students take their notes by hand rather than on a laptop or a tablet computer.
Practice questions are rarely available to students.
exercises.explanation: *Research, however, points in a different direction* ve sonraki cümledeki hatırlama örneği, kendini sınamanın daha etkili olduğunu söyleyen 'Testing oneself appears to be considerably more effective than rereading.' cümlesini gerektirir. 'Rereading notes … is therefore highly recommended' *however* ile kurulan zıtlığı bozar.

exercises.passage: (I) The fictional Tallow Valley railway was built in 1874 to carry coal from the mines to the coast. (II) For almost a century it was the main source of employment in the valley. (III) Coal is formed over millions of years from the remains of ancient plants. (IV) When the mines closed in the 1960s, the line lost most of its traffic and was eventually abandoned. (V) Today a section of it has been restored as a tourist attraction run by volunteers.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf demiryolunun kuruluşundan bugüne kronolojik tarihini anlatır. III. cümle kömürün nasıl oluştuğuna geçer; *coal* kelimesini paylaşsa da akışı (demiryolunun tarihi) bozar.

exercises.passage: (I) Childhood music lessons may have benefits that last well into adulthood. (II) Researchers have found that adults who learned an instrument as children tend to perform better on certain memory tasks. (III) They also appear to be better at distinguishing speech sounds in noisy environments. (IV) The piano, developed in Italy around 1700, remains one of the world's most popular instruments. (V) These benefits seem to last even among adults who have not played for decades.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf çocuklukta müzik eğitiminin yetişkinlikteki faydalarını sıralar; V. cümledeki *These benefits* II. ve III. cümleye bağlanır. IV. cümle piyanonun tarihine geçer ve fayda zincirini böler.

nodes.title: Son bölüm: sınav düzeyi
nodes.description: Diyalog, restatement, paragraf tamamlama ve anlam bütünlüğü: gerçek sınav zorluğunda

exercises.passage:
Journalist: Your study suggests that working from home makes employees more productive. Isn't that exactly what remote workers would want to hear?
Researcher: ----
Journalist: So the improvement can't simply be explained by people reporting what they hoped to find?
Researcher: Precisely. That's why we relied on output records rather than surveys.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: That's a fair point, but we measured the work they actually completed rather than asking how productive they felt.
We are planning to publish a second study next year.
Productivity is notoriously difficult to define in any profession.
Actually, most employees preferred working in the office.
Yes, which is why we interviewed only remote workers about their feelings, their motivation and their daily routines at home.
exercises.explanation: Gazetecinin *So the improvement can't simply be explained by people reporting what they hoped to find?* sorusu ve araştırmacının *we relied on output records rather than surveys* cevabı, boşlukta ölçüm yönteminin açıklandığını gösterir → 'That's a fair point, but we measured the work they actually completed …' 'We interviewed only remote workers about their feelings' son replikle çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Patient: The doctor said I should cut down on salt, but I hardly ever add any to my food.
Nurse: ----
Patient: Really? I had no idea bread could contain so much.
Nurse: Yes, and processed meats and cheese are often even worse.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Have you tried adding fresh herbs and spices to your meals instead of salt when you cook at home?
Salt is essential, so you should never reduce it.
Most of the salt we eat is actually already in foods like bread, not added at the table.
Then you don't need to worry about your diet at all.
Bread is one of the healthiest foods you can eat.
exercises.explanation: Hastanın *I had no idea bread could contain so much* tepkisi, hemşirenin ekmekteki tuzdan söz ettiğini gösterir → 'Most of the salt we eat is actually already in foods like bread …' 'Have you tried adding herbs …' makul bir öneridir ama ekmekten söz etmediği için sonraki replikle bağ kurmaz.

exercises.passage:
Selma: I keep running out of time in the last section of the mock exams.
Coach: Which questions do you start with?
Selma: I go straight through from question one to eighty.
Coach: ----
Selma: That makes sense. I'll try leaving the reading passages until later next time.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: How many hours do you usually sleep before an exam?
Did you buy a new watch for the exam?
Starting from question one and working straight through to the end is really the only sensible approach.
You should spend even more time on each reading passage.
Then you might be spending too long on the reading passages before you reach the quicker questions.
exercises.explanation: Selma'nın *I'll try leaving the reading passages until later* cevabı, koçun okuma metinlerinde çok zaman harcadığını söylediğini gösterir → 'Then you might be spending too long on the reading passages …' 'You should spend even more time on each reading passage' önerinin tam tersidir; 'the only sensible approach' Selma'nın yöntem değiştirmesiyle çelişir.

exercises.question: Not until the final week did she realise how much the timed practice had improved her pace. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: She realised early on that timed practice would slow her down in the final week.
In the final week, she stopped timed practice because she felt that her pace had not improved at all.
It was only in the final week that she realised how much faster the timed practice had made her.
The timed practice improved her pace only during the final week.
She had never realised that timed practice could affect her pace.
exercises.explanation: *Not until … did she realise* = 'ancak son haftada fark etti' → 'It was only in the final week that she realised how much faster the timed practice had made her.' Tuzak: 'The timed practice improved her pace only during the final week' aynı kelimeleri kullanır ama *only*'yi farkına varmadan hızlanmaya taşır; 'had never realised' olumsuzluğu aşırı genişletir.

exercises.question: Had it not been for the scholarship, he could not have afforded to study abroad. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: He turned down the scholarship because he could afford to study abroad.
The scholarship was given to him after he had finished studying abroad.
He would have studied abroad even without the scholarship.
He was able to study abroad only because he received the scholarship.
Although he received the scholarship, he could not afford to study abroad.
exercises.explanation: *Had it not been for X* = 'X olmasaydı'; burs olmasaydı gidemezdi, demek ki burs sayesinde gitti → 'He was able to study abroad only because he received the scholarship.' 'He would have studied abroad even without the scholarship' koşulun anlamını tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: The fictional island of Kerro has no native land mammals. ---- Over thousands of years, several of these birds lost the ability to fly, since they had no predators to escape from. When sailors introduced rats and cats in the nineteenth century, these flightless species were among the first to disappear.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Its birds, however, have always been able to fly long distances.
In their absence, birds came to occupy many of the roles that mammals play elsewhere.
As a result, mammals were introduced to control the bird population.
Rats and cats are among the most common mammals in the world.
The island's sailors were well known throughout the region for their great skill in navigation.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki *these birds* önceki cümlede kuşlardan söz edilmesini gerektirir; memeli yokluğunu kuşlara bağlayan 'In their absence, birds came to occupy many of the roles …' cümlesi bu bağı kurar. 'Its birds … have always been able to fly' sonraki cümledeki uçma yeteneğini kaybetme bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Organisations often respond to a crisis by setting up a committee to investigate what went wrong. Such committees can be valuable, provided they have genuine independence. ---- In those cases, the committee's report tends to confirm what the leadership already wanted to believe, and the real causes of the failure remain unexamined.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Too often, however, their members are chosen by the very managers whose decisions they are meant to examine.
Committee members are usually paid for their work.
Most committees publish their final reports within six months, although some take considerably longer to finish.
This is why crises rarely occur in large organisations.
Independent committees, therefore, are always unnecessary.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki *In those cases* bağımsızlığın olmadığı durumlara gönderme yapar; *provided they have genuine independence* koşulunu bozan 'Too often, however, their members are chosen by the very managers …' gerekir. 'Independent committees … are always unnecessary' önceki cümleyle çelişen aşırı bir genellemedir.

exercises.passage: (I) Desert locusts normally live alone and avoid one another. (II) When heavy rains produce an abundance of vegetation, however, their numbers rise rapidly and they are forced into close contact. (III) This crowding triggers a remarkable change: the insects alter their colour and behaviour and begin to gather in swarms. (IV) Locusts are eaten as a source of protein in several parts of the world. (V) A single swarm can contain millions of insects and destroy crops across vast areas within days.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf çekirgelerin yalnız yaşamdan sürü hâline geçişini neden-sonuç zinciriyle anlatır; V. cümledeki *A single swarm* III. cümledeki sürülere bağlanır. IV. cümle çekirgelerin besin olarak tüketilmesine geçer ve zinciri böler.

exercises.passage: (I) The fictional Ardent Library began lending tools as well as books in 2015. (II) Residents can now borrow drills, ladders and sewing machines for up to a week. (III) The scheme was introduced after a survey showed that most households used such tools only a few times a year. (IV) Since then, borrowing has grown steadily, and the library has added gardening equipment to the collection. (V) Public libraries first appeared in the region in the late nineteenth century.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf kütüphanenin alet ödünç verme uygulamasını anlatır: başlangıç, kapsam, gerekçe ve gelişme. V. cümle bölgedeki halk kütüphanelerinin tarihine geçer. Tuzak: bozan cümle sonda olduğu için genel bir kapanış gibi görünür, ama uygulamayla bağı yoktur.

exercises.passage: (I) Many people assume that multitasking allows them to get more done. (II) Some combinations, such as listening to music while exercising, are widely enjoyed by people of all ages. (III) Studies of office workers, however, suggest that switching between demanding tasks has a hidden cost. (IV) Each switch requires the brain to refocus, and these brief delays add up over the course of a day. (V) Workers who check email constantly, for example, may lose a significant part of their working time in this way.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf çoklu görevin verimliliğe gizli maliyetini anlatır: I. cümledeki varsayımı III. cümle *however* ile çürütür. II. cümle verimliliği değil, keyfi konu edinir ve I ile III arasındaki zıtlık bağını koparır.

nodes.title: Karışık zor set
nodes.description: Son prova: kelime, dilbilgisi, cloze, çeviri, okuma ve son bölüm türlerinden sınav düzeyinde sorular

exercises.question: The negotiations collapsed ---- growing accusations that one side had leaked confidential documents.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra bir isim öbeği gelir; edat gerekir: *amid* = 'ortasında, … sırasında' → 'amid'. 'Likewise', 'nonetheless' ve 'accordingly' zarftır, isim öbeğini cümleye bağlayamaz; 'whatsoever' olumsuzluk pekiştirir.

exercises.question: So convincing ---- that even the most sceptical reviewers recommended the article for publication.
exercises.explanation: *So + sıfat* cümle başına gelince devrik yapı gerekir: *So convincing was the evidence that …* → 'was the evidence'. 'The evidence was' devrik değildir; 'did the evidence' *be* fiiliyle kurulan cümlede *do* yardımcısını yanlış kullanır.

exercises.question: Online courses offer a flexibility that traditional classes cannot match. ----, completion rates remain stubbornly low: in some cases fewer than one in ten students finish.
exercises.explanation: Esneklik olumlu, düşük tamamlama oranı olumsuzdur; zıtlık bağlacı gerekir → 'Nonetheless'. 'Accordingly' sonuç bildirir ve olumluyu olumsuza bağlayamaz; 'That is to say' önceki cümleyi açıklar, zıtlık kurmaz.

exercises.question: Some candidates spend so long checking their answers in the early sections ----.
options: unless they arrive at the exam venue early
so that they can finish the reading section early
as if the reading passages were easier
that they have little time left for the reading passages
which they had already checked twice
exercises.explanation: *so long … that* sonuç kalıbıdır → 'that they have little time left for the reading passages'. 'So that they can finish … early' amaç bildirir ve anlamca terstir; 'which they had already checked twice' *so long* kalıbını tamamlamaz.

exercises.question: Not only did the new timetable reduce waiting times, but it also cut the cost of running the service.
options: Hizmeti yürütmenin maliyeti düştüğü için yeni tarife bekleme sürelerini kısalttı.
Yeni tarife yalnızca bekleme sürelerini kısaltmakla kalmadı, hizmeti yürütmenin maliyetini de düşürdü.
Yeni tarife ne bekleme sürelerini kısalttı ne de hizmetin maliyetini düşürdü.
Yeni tarife bekleme sürelerini kısaltmadı, ama hizmeti yürütmenin maliyetini düşürdü.
Yeni tarife bekleme sürelerini kısalttı, ancak hizmeti yürütmenin maliyeti arttı.
exercises.explanation: *Not only … but also* = 'yalnızca … kalmadı, … da' → 'Yeni tarife yalnızca bekleme sürelerini kısaltmakla kalmadı, hizmeti yürütmenin maliyetini de düşürdü.' Tuzak: *Not only*'deki *not* olumsuzluk sanılırsa 'kısaltmadı' diyen çeviri seçilir; 'maliyet düştüğü için' diyen çeviri olmayan bir neden-sonuç bağı kurar.

exercises.passage: For most of the twentieth century, the fictional coastal town of Wrenmouth relied on a concrete sea wall to protect it from storms. When the wall needed expensive repairs in 2010, the council took a controversial decision: rather than rebuild it, they allowed part of the coast to flood naturally, creating a salt marsh. Many residents were furious, arguing that the council was abandoning them to the sea. Ten years later, opinion has shifted. The marsh absorbs the energy of incoming waves so effectively that flooding in the town has actually decreased, and the cost of maintaining it is a fraction of what repairing the wall would have been. The marsh has also attracted birdwatchers, bringing unexpected income to local cafés. Not everyone has been won over; a few farmers who lost fields to the marsh still feel they were poorly compensated. Still, the scheme is now widely cited as a model for other coastal communities.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the council's decision ----.
options: was supported by every resident from the beginning, including the local farmers
led to more frequent flooding in the town
has proved more successful than many residents had initially expected
was reversed after the farmers complained
was made mainly in order to attract birdwatchers
exercises.explanation: Sakinler başta öfkeliydi (*furious*), on yıl sonra görüş değişti ve sel azaldı → 'has proved more successful than many residents had initially expected'. 'Supported by every resident' *furious* ile çelişir; 'made mainly to attract birdwatchers' kuş gözlemcilerinin *unexpected* bir gelir olmasıyla çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Interviewer: You've said that the exam measures reading skills more than anything else. Could you explain why?
Expert: ----
Interviewer: So even the grammar and vocabulary questions are really reading questions in disguise?
Expert: In a sense, yes. Very few questions can be answered without understanding a full sentence or paragraph.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Actually, vocabulary is far more important than reading, since most of the questions in the exam test knowledge of individual words and phrases.
Because grammar is no longer tested in the exam.
Reading is the section that most candidates enjoy.
Well, almost every question requires candidates to understand a sentence in context, not just to recognise a rule or a word.
I think candidates should read newspapers every day.
exercises.explanation: Görüşmecinin *So even the grammar and vocabulary questions are really reading questions in disguise?* sorusu, uzmanın her sorunun bağlam içinde cümle anlamayı gerektirdiğini söylediğini gösterir → 'Well, almost every question requires candidates to understand a sentence in context …' 'Grammar is no longer tested' görüşmecinin *even the grammar … questions* ifadesiyle çelişir.

exercises.question: It is not so much a lack of knowledge as poor time management that prevents many candidates from reaching their target score. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: A lack of knowledge is the main reason why candidates manage their time poorly.
Candidates with good time management always reach their target score, whatever their knowledge.
Few candidates reach their target score, although their knowledge and time management are good.
Many candidates lack both the knowledge and the time management skills that they would need in order to reach their target score.
Many candidates miss their target score mainly because they manage their time badly rather than because they lack knowledge.
exercises.explanation: *not so much X as Y* = 'X'ten çok Y' → 'Many candidates miss their target score mainly because they manage their time badly rather than because they lack knowledge.' 'Lack both …' iki nedeni eşitler; 'A lack of knowledge is the main reason …' karşılaştırmanın yönünü tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: When a new species of frog was discovered on a remote mountain in the fictional country of Vessaria, scientists were delighted. ---- Within two years, the frog's population had fallen by almost half, and investigators found that dozens had been collected illegally for sale to private collectors abroad. The scientists now regret having published the exact location of their discovery.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Their excitement, however, soon turned to concern.
The mountain was later declared a protected area, which ended all illegal collecting.
The frog was named after the scientist who found it.
As a result, the population of the frog doubled within two years.
Frogs are found on every continent except Antarctica.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümlede sevinç, sonrakinde nüfusun yarıya düşmesi anlatılır; geçişi kuran 'Their excitement, however, soon turned to concern.' cümlesidir. 'Population … doubled' sonraki cümleyle çelişir; 'ended all illegal collecting' son cümledeki pişmanlıkla uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage: (I) In the fictional city of Pellam, a pilot scheme replaced the parking spaces on one shopping street with wider pavements and benches. (II) Shopkeepers initially opposed the plan, fearing that customers who could no longer park outside would go elsewhere. (III) Pellam's population has grown steadily since a new university opened there in the 1990s. (IV) A year later, however, the street's shops reported a rise in sales, as more people stopped to sit and browse. (V) The council is now considering extending the scheme to three more streets.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf bir sokak düzenlemesini, esnafın itirazını, sonucunu ve genişletme planını anlatır; IV. cümledeki *however* II. cümledeki kaygıya cevap verir. III. cümle kentin nüfus artışına geçer ve bu bağı koparır.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 20 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The organisers apologised for the ---- caused by the last-minute change of exam venue.
exercises.explanation: Son dakika yer değişikliği adaylara zahmet çıkarır; özür bunun içindir → 'inconvenience'. 'Composure' (soğukkanlılık) ve 'stamina' (dayanıklılık) bir değişikliğin yol açtığı olumsuzluk değildir.

exercises.question: Although she was nervous before the interview, she kept her ---- and answered every question calmly.
exercises.explanation: *kept her … and answered calmly* soğukkanlılığını koruduğunu gösterir; *keep one's composure* kalıbı → 'composure'. 'Setback' (aksilik) ve 'pitfall' (tuzak) korunacak bir şey değildir; 'keep her appointment' randevuya gitmek demektir ve *calmly* ile bağ kurmaz.

exercises.question: By the time the results are announced next month, most candidates ---- their university applications.
exercises.explanation: *By the time + geniş zaman* gelecekteki bir ana kadar tamamlanmış eylemi gösterir → 'will have submitted'. 'Had submitted' geçmişteki bir ana göredir; 'have submitted' *next month* ile uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: The professor, ---- advice many students had ignored, turned out to be right about the difficulty of the final exam.
exercises.explanation: Tavsiye profesöre aittir (profesörün tavsiyesi) → 'whose'. 'Who's' (*who is*) ile karıştırılır; 'that' virgülden sonra kullanılmaz; 'whom' arkasından gelen *advice* ile iyelik bağı kuramaz.

exercises.passage: Exam anxiety is often regarded as a purely negative experience. (1) ----, a moderate level of stress can actually improve performance by sharpening attention. Problems arise only when anxiety becomes so intense (2) ---- it interferes with memory and reasoning. Psychologists therefore recommend that candidates learn to interpret physical signs such as a racing heart (3) ---- signals that the body is preparing for a challenge, rather than as warnings of failure.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle kaygıyı tamamen olumsuz sayan görüşü verir; sonraki cümle stresin performansı artırabileceğini söyler. Zıtlık gerekir → 'However'. 'Similarly' ve 'In addition' aynı yönde devam eder; 'As a result' neden-sonuç bağı kurar.

exercises.passage: Exam anxiety is often regarded as a purely negative experience. (1) ----, a moderate level of stress can actually improve performance by sharpening attention. Problems arise only when anxiety becomes so intense (2) ---- it interferes with memory and reasoning. Psychologists therefore recommend that candidates learn to interpret physical signs such as a racing heart (3) ---- signals that the body is preparing for a challenge, rather than as warnings of failure.
exercises.question: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: *so + sıfat + that* sonuç kalıbıdır: *so intense that it interferes* → 'that'. 'As' ve 'than' karşılaştırma yapar; 'which' arkasındaki tam cümleyi bağlayamaz.

exercises.passage: Exam anxiety is often regarded as a purely negative experience. (1) ----, a moderate level of stress can actually improve performance by sharpening attention. Problems arise only when anxiety becomes so intense (2) ---- it interferes with memory and reasoning. Psychologists therefore recommend that candidates learn to interpret physical signs such as a racing heart (3) ---- signals that the body is preparing for a challenge, rather than as warnings of failure.
exercises.question: (3) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
exercises.explanation: *interpret X as Y* kalıbıdır; cümlenin sonundaki *rather than as warnings* bu yapıyı tekrar eder → 'as'. 'Like' benzetme bildirir ve *interpret* ile kalıp oluşturmaz; 'for' da bu fiille kullanılmaz.

exercises.question: Unless you read the question stem before the passage, ----.
options: the passage had been easier to understand
you will always choose the correct answer, even in the longest passages
you would have found the answer more quickly
as the passage is usually too long
you may waste time looking for information that is not relevant
exercises.explanation: *Unless* (-medikçe) birinci tip koşul gibi şimdiki ya da gelecek bir sonuç ister → 'you may waste time looking for information that is not relevant'. 'Would have found' üçüncü tip koşula aittir; 'you will always choose the correct answer' anlamca terstir.

exercises.question: ----, she decided to postpone her exam by six months.
options: Even though she felt completely unprepared for the vocabulary section of the exam
Realising that her vocabulary was still far below the required level
Having already achieved the score she needed
So that the exam would be held earlier
exercises.explanation: Sınavı ertelemenin mantıklı nedeni kelime bilgisinin yetersiz olduğunu fark etmesidir → 'Realising that her vocabulary was still far below the required level'. 'Even though she felt completely unprepared' zıtlık kurar, oysa hazırsızlık ertelemenin nedenidir; 'Having already achieved the score' ertelemeyi anlamsız kılar.

exercises.question: While the first half of the exam rewards accurate knowledge of grammar and vocabulary, ----.
options: so candidates should memorise grammar rules
it is held on the same day as the second half, usually early in the morning
which is why it lasts three hours
the second half depends far more on reading speed and comprehension
exercises.explanation: *While* burada zıtlık bildirir; ilk yarıyla karşılaştırılan ikinci yarı gelmelidir → 'the second half depends far more on reading speed and comprehension'. 'So candidates should …' *While* ile kurulan cümleye bağlaç eklenemez; 'it is held on the same day' zıtlık kurmaz.

exercises.question: Sınavdan önceki gece yeni konular çalışmak yerine erken yatmak, çoğu aday için daha faydalı olacaktır.
options: Studying new topics early is more beneficial than going to bed late before the exam.
Going to bed early the night before the exam, rather than studying new topics, will be more beneficial for most candidates.
The night before the exam, most candidates go to bed early instead of studying new topics, as their teachers usually advise them to do.
Most candidates benefit from studying new topics late on the night before the exam.
Unless they study new topics, most candidates cannot sleep the night before the exam.
exercises.explanation: '… yerine erken yatmak … daha faydalı olacaktır' bir öneri ve karşılaştırmadır → 'Going to bed early …, rather than studying new topics, will be more beneficial for most candidates.' Tuzak: 'most candidates go to bed early instead of …' aynı kelimeleri kullanır ama öneriyi bir alışkanlık bildirimine çevirir ve *more beneficial* karşılaştırmasını atar.

exercises.question: The candidates who scored highest were not necessarily those who studied the longest, but those who reviewed their mistakes most carefully.
options: En yüksek puanı alan adaylar, mutlaka en uzun süre çalışanlar değil, hatalarını en dikkatli biçimde gözden geçirenlerdi.
Sınavda en yüksek puanı alan adaylar hem en uzun süre çalışmış hem de hatalarını her zaman en dikkatli biçimde gözden geçirmişti.
Hatalarını dikkatle gözden geçiren adaylar en uzun süre çalışanlardı ve en yüksek puanı onlar aldı.
En uzun süre çalışan adaylar, hatalarını gözden geçirmedikleri için en yüksek puanı alamadı.
Adaylar hatalarını ne kadar dikkatli gözden geçirirse o kadar uzun süre çalışmak zorunda kaldı.
exercises.explanation: *not necessarily X, but Y* = 'mutlaka X değil, Y' → 'En yüksek puanı alan adaylar, mutlaka en uzun süre çalışanlar değil, hatalarını en dikkatli biçimde gözden geçirenlerdi.' 'Hem en uzun süre çalışmış hem de …' *not necessarily* zıtlığını atar; 'gözden geçirmedikleri için … alamadı' metinde olmayan bir neden kurar.

exercises.passage: The fictional town of Ostby introduced a quiet hour in its supermarkets in 2021: for one hour each morning, music was switched off, lights were dimmed and checkout announcements were stopped. The scheme was designed for people with autism and other conditions that make bright, noisy environments distressing. Store managers expected only a small number of shoppers to use it. To their surprise, the quiet hour soon became one of the busiest periods of the week, attracting elderly customers, parents with young children and many shoppers who simply preferred a calmer atmosphere. Sales during the hour rose by about twelve per cent compared with the same time the previous year. Some managers have since questioned whether stores need loud music at any time of day, although head office remains reluctant to make permanent changes, arguing that music encourages customers to buy on impulse.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the quiet hour was originally intended for ----.
options: customers who usually shop late at night
shoppers who tend to buy on impulse
people who find bright and noisy surroundings distressing
store managers who wanted a calmer workplace for their staff
elderly customers and parents with young children
exercises.explanation: *The scheme was designed for people with autism and other conditions that make bright, noisy environments distressing* → 'people who find bright and noisy surroundings distressing'. Tuzak: 'elderly customers and parents with young children' metinde geçer, ama sonradan gelen müşterilerdir; asıl hedef kitle değildir.

exercises.passage: The fictional town of Ostby introduced a quiet hour in its supermarkets in 2021: for one hour each morning, music was switched off, lights were dimmed and checkout announcements were stopped. The scheme was designed for people with autism and other conditions that make bright, noisy environments distressing. Store managers expected only a small number of shoppers to use it. To their surprise, the quiet hour soon became one of the busiest periods of the week, attracting elderly customers, parents with young children and many shoppers who simply preferred a calmer atmosphere. Sales during the hour rose by about twelve per cent compared with the same time the previous year. Some managers have since questioned whether stores need loud music at any time of day, although head office remains reluctant to make permanent changes, arguing that music encourages customers to buy on impulse.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that head office ----.
options: believes the quiet hour has reduced sales
has decided to switch off music in all its stores permanently from next year
was unaware that the quiet hour existed
is not yet convinced that removing music would benefit stores overall
originally designed the scheme for elderly customers
exercises.explanation: Genel müdürlük kalıcı değişikliğe isteksizdir (*reluctant*) ve müziğin anlık alışverişi artırdığını savunur → 'is not yet convinced that removing music would benefit stores overall'. 'Has decided to switch off music … permanently' *reluctant* ile çelişir; 'believes the quiet hour has reduced sales' satışların %12 artmasıyla uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage: A common belief holds that people who read fiction become more empathetic. A series of experiments at the fictional University of Calden has tried to test this idea more rigorously than earlier work. Participants were randomly assigned to read either a short literary story, a popular thriller or a non-fiction article, and then completed tasks measuring their ability to recognise other people's emotions. The literary-story readers did slightly better than the others, but the effect was small and disappeared entirely when the experiment was repeated a month later with the same participants. The researchers conclude that any short-term boost from a single story is modest at best. They stress, however, that their design cannot tell us whether reading fiction regularly over many years has a lasting effect, which is the question that matters most to teachers and parents.
exercises.question: The researchers' view of the claim that fiction makes readers more empathetic is best described as ----.
options: indifferent, as they consider the question unimportant
hostile, as they think teachers should stop assigning fiction
dismissive, as they claim to have proved that fiction has no effect at all on readers of any age, culture or background
cautious, as they found only a modest short-term effect but leave the long-term question open
enthusiastic, as they believe a single story greatly improves empathy
exercises.explanation: Araştırmacılar kısa vadeli etkiyi *modest at best* bulur ama uzun vadeli soruyu açık bırakır → 'cautious, as they found only a modest short-term effect but leave the long-term question open'. 'Dismissive … proved that fiction has no effect' aşırı genellemedir; araştırmacılar düzenli okumanın etkisini ölçemediklerini açıkça söyler.

exercises.passage: A common belief holds that people who read fiction become more empathetic. A series of experiments at the fictional University of Calden has tried to test this idea more rigorously than earlier work. Participants were randomly assigned to read either a short literary story, a popular thriller or a non-fiction article, and then completed tasks measuring their ability to recognise other people's emotions. The literary-story readers did slightly better than the others, but the effect was small and disappeared entirely when the experiment was repeated a month later with the same participants. The researchers conclude that any short-term boost from a single story is modest at best. They stress, however, that their design cannot tell us whether reading fiction regularly over many years has a lasting effect, which is the question that matters most to teachers and parents.
exercises.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage?
options: Participants were assigned to their reading material at random.
Thriller readers became less empathetic over time.
Literary-story readers performed slightly better at first.
The long-term effect of regular reading remains untested.
The experiment was repeated a month later.
exercises.explanation: Gerilim romanı okuyanların zamanla empatisinin azaldığı metinde yoktur → 'Thriller readers became less empathetic over time.' Rastgele atama, bir ay sonra tekrar, edebi öykü okuyanların ilk testteki küçük üstünlüğü ve uzun vadeli etkinin ölçülmemesi metinde geçer.

exercises.passage:
Aylin: I've got my exam tomorrow and I still haven't revised the last two units.
Bora: ----
Aylin: But what if those units come up?
Bora: Even if they do, a couple of questions won't matter as much as being exhausted for all eighty.
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Honestly, I'd leave them and get a good night's sleep instead.
Don't worry, the exam has been postponed.
I took the same exam last year.
Which units have you already revised?
You should stay up all night and finish them, then, even if you feel tired tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Aylin'in *But what if those units come up?* itirazı, kendisine o üniteleri bırakmasının önerildiğini gösterir; Bora'nın son repliği de yorgunluktan söz eder → 'Honestly, I'd leave them and get a good night's sleep instead.' 'Stay up all night and finish them' son replikteki *being exhausted* uyarısıyla çelişir.

exercises.question: Candidates are advised to leave a difficult question and return to it later rather than spend too long on it. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: Candidates who return to questions later usually change their answers.
Candidates should spend as long as necessary on difficult questions before moving on to the easier ones in the next section.
It is recommended that candidates move on from a hard question and come back to it instead of dwelling on it.
Candidates are advised to answer the difficult questions first.
Difficult questions should never be attempted during the exam.
exercises.explanation: *are advised to leave … and return to it later rather than spend too long* → 'It is recommended that candidates move on from a hard question and come back to it instead of dwelling on it.' 'Should never be attempted' *return to it later* bilgisini atar ve aşırı genelleme yapar; 'answer the difficult questions first' öneriyi tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: Many candidates spend the last few days before an exam trying to learn as many new words as possible. ---- Words studied in a hurry are rarely remembered under pressure, and the effort leaves little time for reviewing what has already been learned. A better use of these days is to go over earlier mistakes and to take one final timed practice test.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Most dictionaries contain more than a hundred thousand words.
As a result, they usually remember every word they study.
Some exams do not include vocabulary questions at all.
This is the most effective way to improve a score quickly.
This strategy, however, is seldom effective.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki cümle aceleyle çalışılan kelimelerin hatırlanmadığını söyler; önceki stratejiyi eleştiren 'This strategy, however, is seldom effective.' gerekir. 'The most effective way …' ve 'they usually remember every word' sonraki cümleyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: (I) On the morning of the exam, a light breakfast can help candidates stay focused, whereas a heavy meal may leave them sleepy during the long reading section. (II) Breakfast cereals were first produced commercially in the second half of the nineteenth century. (III) It is also wise to bring a bottle of water, since even mild dehydration can affect concentration. (IV) Candidates should also check that they have their identity card and the required stationery. (V) Finally, they should arrive early enough to find their room without rushing.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf sınav sabahı için pratik önerileri sıralar (*also, also, Finally*). II. cümle kahvaltılık gevreklerin tarihine geçer; *breakfast* kelimesini paylaşsa da öneri dizisini böler.
